answer_2.quote: Specifically, we utilize four evaluation metrics across various levels: 1) Chrf++: character level, 2) SentencePieceBleu (SpBleu): tokenized sub-word level, 3) Sacrebleu: detokenized word level, and 4) COMET: representation level.
